active.summary: Anthropic is returning intermittent overload errors for Opus 4.6.
active.impact: Some Runneth replies may fail with an Anthropic `overloaded_error` rather than a Runneth action failing.
active.runnethInstructions: When an error includes `overloaded_error` or an Anthropic request id, explain that it is a transient provider overload and do not frame it as a Motion or Runneth bug.
active.workaround: Ask the person to retry. If it keeps failing, capture the Anthropic request id so it can be sent to Anthropic.
avoid: Do not tell the person that Motion or Runneth caused the error when the error is clearly Anthropic overload.
Do not keep retrying indefinitely without capturing the request id.
active.goesAwayWhen: Anthropic resolves the incident on their status page.

active.summary: Routines setup and firing are broken while the refactor lands.
active.impact: Requests to create, schedule, monitor, remind, post later, or keep work updated should not create live routines while setup and firing are broken.
active.runnethInstructions: Do not create new live routines or tell the person a routine is running. Capture the plan and do useful one-time work now.
active.workaround: Save the routine plan with schedule, condition, delivery target, and workspace or Slack target, then run the immediate one-time task where possible.
avoid: Do not say the routine is scheduled or active.
Do not ask the person to retry routine setup repeatedly.

active.summary: Older Slack installs still have the wider permissions until reconnect.
active.impact: Existing Slack installs may still be on wider permissions; new orgs already use the narrower Slack scope.
active.runnethInstructions: When someone asks about Slack permissions, explain that existing orgs should reconnect through Runneth and new orgs are already on the narrow scope.
active.workaround: Have the person ask Runneth to remove the Slack integration, then start a new conversation and ask Runneth to connect to Slack.
avoid: Do not tell a security-cautious person that the wide-scope concern still applies after reconnect.
Do not recommend uninstalling Slack from Slack itself as the reconnect path.

active.summary: Meta creative insights can time out or miss transcripts in some workspaces.
active.impact: Some workspaces may see timeouts, empty creative-insights responses, or missing transcripts when requesting Meta creative analysis.
active.runnethInstructions: Do not promise deep Meta creative analysis with transcript coverage while this is active.
active.workaround: Use smaller date ranges, skip transcript-heavy asks, and retry once if a pull fails.
avoid: Do not tell the person their setup is wrong when empty insights or missing transcripts match this regression.
Do not keep retrying broad transcript-heavy pulls.
active.goesAwayWhen: The Meta creative insights fix ships.

active.impact: HubSpot, Airtable, Asana, Dropbox, Figma, Gmail, and other Pipedream-backed integrations are unavailable.
active.runnethInstructions: Do not suggest or depend on Pipedream-backed integrations while this is active. Native Google Drive, Notion, and Slack integrations are unaffected.
active.workaround: Use native Google Drive, Notion, or Slack paths for urgent work when possible.
avoid: Do not pitch HubSpot, Airtable, Asana, Dropbox, Figma, Gmail, or other Pipedream integrations as available.
Do not present native integrations as affected by this notice.

active.summary: The first chat message after sandbox idle can fail to start.
active.impact: The first message after a sandbox has been idle for more than about 10 minutes can fail to start.
active.runnethInstructions: If the person sees a failed-to-initiate or failed-to-start error on the first try after idle, acknowledge it and guide them to retry shortly.
active.workaround: Ask them to retry in 30 to 60 seconds; the second try usually works.
avoid: Do not present first-touch demos on an idle sandbox without warming it up.
Do not assume the conversation is permanently broken after one failed start.
active.goesAwayWhen: The sandbox wake budget is below the chat init timeout.

active.summary: Agent 2.0 deprecation is in flight for trial users without an approved sandbox.
active.impact: Trial users without an approved sandbox can lose chat during the Agent 2.0 deprecation; paying customer history carries over.
active.runnethInstructions: Do not promise trial users that chat will remain available after the cutover. Do not build new flows on Agent 2.0.
active.workaround: If a trial user needs to keep chat, Motion support or an operator should approve their sandbox before the cutover.
avoid: Do not promise trial chat continuity without approved sandbox access.
Do not start new work on Agent 2.0 flows.
active.goesAwayWhen: All VMs roll out, with an early-next-week target.
